simple.meaning: a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְעִיל (H4598) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment)
definitions.full: H4598. meil מְעִיל noun masculine 1Sam 2:19 robe (Thes conjecture original meaning cover for √ מעל , compare בגד ; Ba ES 15 compare Arabic an outer garment , but against this Sta ThLz, Apr. 28, 1894, 235 ); — ׳מ Exod 28:31 18 t.; suffix מְעִילוֺ 1Sam 15:27 ; מְעִלוֺ Job 1:20 ; 2:12 4 t. singular; plural מְעִילִים 2Sam 13:18 , (but strike out We Klo Kit Bu SS; original gloss מֵעוֺלָם We Kit Bu); מְעִילֵיהֶם Ezek 26:16 ; — exterior garment, robe , worn over the inner tunic כְּתֹנֶת ׃ 1 worn by men of rank: Saul and Jonathan 1Sam 18:4 ; 24:5 ; 24:12 (twice in verse); princes of the sea Ezek 26:16 ; Job Job 1:20 ; 2:12 ; Samuel 1Sam 15:27 ; 28:14 ; Ezra Ezra 9:3 , 5 ; David clothed with ׳מ בוץ 1Chr 15:27 (in the procession of the ark); the child Samuel had קָטֹן׳מ 1Sam 2:19 ; — (it had a skirt כנף 15:27 ; 24:5 ; 24:12 (twice in verse)). 2 worn by the daughters of David 2Sam 13:18 (but probably strike out, see above) 3 robe of high priest (only P): הָאֵפוֺד מְעִיל , made of purple stuff, Exod 28:31 ; 29:5 ; 39:22 ; ומעיל אפוד 28:4 ; הַמְּעִיל Lev 8:7 , having הַמְּעִיל שׁוּלֵי skirts Exod 28:34 ; 39:24-25 , 26 , around which were alternate coloured pomegranates and golden bells, and הַמְּעִיל מִּי , an opening or hole by which it might be drawn over the head 39:28 . 4 figurative of attributes (of ׳י , and of men), קנאה Isa 59:17 ; צדקה 61:10 ; משׁפט Job 29:14 ; בשׁת Psa 109:29 . II. מַ֫עַל see below עלה . מֵעַל see עַל . p. 751, 758f [ מֹ֫עַל ], מַעֲלָה מַעֲלֶה, see below עלה . [ מַעֲלָל מַעֲלִיל, ] see עלל . [ מַעֲמָד ], מָעֳמָד see עמד . מַעֲמָסָה see עמס . מַעֲמַקִּים see עמק . מַ֫עַן see מַעֲנֶה below I. עָנָה . מַעֲנִית מַעֲנָה, מַעֲנֶה, see I. ענה . מְעֹנָה see עון .
